name: Jagari Mukherjee

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Jagari Mukherjee is a poet and editor whose collections include The Elegant Nobody (Hawakal, 2020) and Exit Noire (BookWryter, 2023). The Elegant Nobody was shortlisted for the Rabindranath Tagore Literary Prize for 2021–22. She is also associated with the literary journal EKL Review as its Chief Executive Editor.

“My Sister and I Comb a Doll’s Hair” begins with the bright colours and careful gestures of play. Its final disclosure—that the sisters are childless, middle-aged women—turns attention toward the reader’s expectations. The doll’s silence holds a tenderness that resists easy explanation or judgment.
